panels.description: The passage opens into old lithium workings. A broad maintained industrial uplink crosses above a narrow pipe labeled KEEL RESIDENTIAL; keep the upper chamber clear.
The residential pipe is nearly dry, stained orange and white. Keep the upper pipe area clear.
A newer white-and-amber node glows beside an analog gauge; Adrian's equation is scratched into its housing. Keep the upper node clear.
Alex presses his palm to the broad industrial pipe while B11 watches. Keep the upper pipe clear.
